description: Synthetic long project conversation (a website where people post problems). t = time order, bigger is newer.

corpus.text: We want a website where people post problems they face and others suggest solutions.
Stack decision: Python FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, plain HTML and JavaScript front end.
Stage 1 done: pages are Home, Post a Problem, Problem Detail, Login.
The problems table has columns id, title, description, category_id, author_id, created_at.
Categories are Health, Education, Transport, Money, Other.
Learner asked what an HTTP route is; we explained GET versus POST using the submit form.
Submit form posts to /api/problems and returns 201 with the new problem id.
Bug: empty titles were accepted. Fixed by rejecting titles shorter than 3 characters with a 422.
Decision: passwords are hashed with bcrypt; never stored in plain text.
Decision change: switched password hashing from bcrypt to argon2.
Learner struggles with SQL JOIN; example used problems joined with categories.
Votes table: id, problem_id, user_id, value; a user can vote once per problem (unique constraint).
Solutions table links to problems through problem_id and has an accepted flag.
Deployment target is Render free plan; database is on Supabase.
Stage 5 quiz: learner answered that GET requests should not change data. Correct.
Learner prefers short explanations and examples in Python.
Search feature uses ILIKE on title and description; ranking by votes.
Rate limit: max 5 problem posts per user per hour.
Decision change: rate limit raised from 5 to 10 posts per hour.
Environment variable DATABASE_URL holds the connection string; never commit it.
Learner asked about indentation in Python; explained 4 spaces and why blocks matter.
Bug hunt exercise: planted off-by-one error in pagination; learner fixed it in 6 minutes.
Moderation: flagged problems go to a review queue visible to admins only.
Admin role is stored in users.role; checked on the server for every admin route.
Front end uses fetch() to call the API and renders cards with a template string.
Pagination returns 20 problems per page.
Learner's goal: confidently write back-end code alone after this project.
Email verification is planned but not built yet.
Test suite uses pytest; 14 tests pass.
Decision: no real names displayed; use usernames.
